data.name: Rohid
data.gender_notes: Rohid is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rohid is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohini', which means 'brave' or 'strong'. In Hindu mythology, Rohini is a star in the constellation of Taurus, and is also identified with the goddess of the same name, who is considered the mother of the moon. The name Rohid carries the meaning “Brave, Strong” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rohid usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rohid is a name that represents courage, strength, and divine protection. It is a name that is often given to boys who are expected to grow up to be strong and brave leaders.
data.etymology: Rohid belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohid total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Rohid is believed to represent the indomitable spirit and strength present within an individual. historical_references.reference: Rohid was a king in Magadha Province of ancient India around 5th century BC. He was a contemporary of Buddha and is mentioned in some Buddhist texts as a patron of Buddhism.
Rohid is also mentioned in Mahabharata, an epic Sanskrit text of ancient India, as a descendant of the Lunar Dynasty and a king of Haihayas.
